comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DISPATCH INCIDENT, recorded: the round-1 dispatch launched 2026-07-25 18:24 and idled four hours with sixteen agent starts and zero completions — every transcript ends in a stream interruption, the signature of the host sleeping between attended-session turns (in-flight lens streams cut on sleep, the workflow respawning on wake, sleeping again). No lens ever returned, so no review content was lost and the manifest stands unchanged; the run was stopped and relaunched under the live session at 22:31. CONDUCT NOTE for the attended/autonomous split: this is precisely the detached-execution-on-an-attended-vehicle shape the contract names — a long-running dispatch on a host whose wake-state tracks the operator's presence. The Workflow surface remains lawful for attended rounds (round completes within a session turn when the host is awake); the durable fix is the contract's own: container-backed autonomous dispatch (Layer 8's preflighted vehicle) for anything that must survive the operator walking away. The observed sixteen-restart cost is the incident's price tag; downstream tokens from the dead starts are capture-sourced and will be reported in this round's telemetry as waste, separate from the live run's spend.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 1 RETURNED (relaunched run; the incident record above covers the dead first launch). Four lenses, 27 findings pre-dedup, consolidated to seven children: #776 (major, SE+UX convergent, binary-confirmed live: a broken member of the composed multi-repo display renders the bare broken-state mark with no repo identity — two broken repos are indistinguishable; segment_for_repo itself untested), #777 (major, security, binary-confirmed live: state-sourced strings — current_phase, composition scope and domains — reach the segment and human form with no control-character cleaning; an ESC or newline in adopter-edited state.yaml injects into the terminal on every refresh, and crosslink-sourced strings get cleaning the state-sourced ones lack), #778 (major, QE+SE convergent: the wall-clock conduct test times a stubbed acquisition — the registered scope says acquisition through render, and a 10-second hung acquirer passes unmeasured; per_repo_budget_ms is parsed, tested, and consumed by nothing, so one wedged member repo stalls the whole composed display ~20s), #779 (major, QE, executed-mutant evidence: the worded-absence branch is dead code under the suite because the absences fixture pre-materializes the words; render_human has NO absence handling — an empty display field prints an empty slot on exactly the surface the criterion words; the generic truncation branch, the degraded marker's only-if half, the stdin and wall-clock instruments, the machine report.degraded block, the milestone's place in field order, and the byte-identity/superset/color-strip per-fixture quantifiers are all unfalsified — hardcoded-zero and unconditional-marker mutants survive all 18 tests), #780 (minor SE collector: the open-count split accepts any tail ending in ' open)' — a countless milestone named '... (kept open)' gets savaged under the #680 rule meant for the real gauge, breaking symmetry with the acquisition's digit-exact strip; fit() emits over-budget renderings when budgets saturate below mark length; the phase field's ' L{n}' suffix dies first under truncation — the gauge-survival order inverted), #781 (minor collector: the repo-set config reads uncapped where every sibling adopter read honors the 1MiB cap; the wiring script silently degrades to single-repo when an explicitly named config is missing; current-repo dedup compares uncanonicalized paths so a symlinked spelling renders the repo twice; the composition guidance names 'the invocation line below' above two conditional lines), #782 (nit collector: 'degraded — tracker-unusable: tracker degraded — tracker data unusable' restates one fact three times before the actionable half; the broken forms carry the absolute state path with the home segment — display-surface disposition to record). TELEMETRY, chosen versus observed: model chosen=observed claude-fable-5 all four; effort chosen=observed (SE/security high, QE/UX medium); band DECLARED 150k-320k, OBSERVED 286,211 with 132 tool invocations — IN BAND. Incident waste, separate: the dead first launch burned sixteen partial lens starts across four hours of host sleep; capture-sourced accounting rides the harvest. The UX slot earned its place: the display-identity major and both copy findings are its lineage. Fix pass follows under the standing continuation conduct.
